The investigation traced 14 distinct blockchain entities linked to the seed wallet 0xa7f39c1d8e4b2a5f7c3d9e0a1b8c6d4e5f2a67e9, involving 17 transfers across a maximum depth of three hops. Sixteen transfers were confirmed, with one inferred correlation, and 16 of the transfers met or exceeded the 30 % reporting threshold. The fund movement began at 10:31:04 IST on 8 September 2026, with the first outbound transaction recorded three minutes later (10:35:02) via address E04, followed by rapid dispersal to multiple recipients, interaction with a mixer contract (address 0x8589f2c47b1d0a63e95482f7ca1b3d6e0f4a0b6f, moving 1,500 USDT), and subsequent routing through a cross‑chain bridge (0xbb17d4a09e26c35f81b0d7a94e13c68f05b2c530) within two downstream hops.

Risk scoring assigns the seed wallet a high score of 65/100, reflecting proximity to a known scam cluster (+20), rapid automated dispersal (+15), mixer interaction (+15) and bridge exposure (+15). The highest‑scoring entity observed is 0x9c04a7e3b21d5f86c0a94e7d2b83f150c6ead21e with a critical score of 75/100, followed by the seed wallet (65/100) and 0x3f1a7d92c04e8b56af10d3e7b829c45d6e0a71bc (35/100).
